test_cases.title: Start of Mission triggers session establishment in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, no active communication session, Start of Mission procedure is initiated.

steps.action: Initiate Start of Mission procedure in Level 2.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Trackside order triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, no active communication session.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish communication session.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Manual level change to Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1, no active communication session.

steps.action: Driver manually changes the level to Level 2.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Engine rear end reaching end of radio hole triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, train is approaching the end of an announced radio hole, no active communication session.

steps.action: Train moves such that the engine rear end reaches the end of the announced radio hole.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Loss of safe radio connection triggers re-establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, an active communication session exists, safe radio connection is lost.

steps.action: Simulate loss of safe radio connection causing the previous session to be considered terminated.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a new communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Driver manual selection of RBC contact info outside SoM triggers session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, outside Start of Mission procedure, no active communication session.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid RBC contact information.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC contact information.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Session establishment sequence with compatible version
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to establish a session, trackside is available and compatible.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment.
steps.expected: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection.

steps.action: Safe radio connection is established.
steps.expected: OBU sends Initiation of communication session.

steps.action: OBU receives system version from trackside.
steps.expected: OBU considers the session established and sends a session established report.

test_cases.title: Session establishment with incompatible version
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to establish a session, trackside sends an incompatible system version.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment and receive incompatible system version.
steps.expected: OBU sends 'No compatible version supported', informs the driver, and terminates the session.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on trackside order (FRMCS-only RBC)
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Trackside order specifies an RBC interfaced with FRMCS only.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order for FRMCS-only RBC.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with FRMCS-only RBC.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using FRMCS.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on driver choice at SoM
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Driver elected single radio system (GSM-R) during SoM.

steps.action: Initiate session establishment after SoM where driver chose GSM-R.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using GSM-R.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on stored info and preferred system
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. No trackside order or specific driver single-radio choice. Previous session used FRMCS.

steps.action: Initiate session establishment.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using FRMCS (preferred system from previous session).

test_cases.title: Memorisation of successful radio system
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Session establishment is triggered.

steps.action: Establish a communication session successfully using GSM-R.
steps.expected: OBU stores GSM-R as the radio system used for the successful safe radio connection set-up.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to End of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in the process of establishing a communication session (safe radio connection requested but system version not yet received).

steps.action: Perform End of Mission while session establishment is ongoing.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to trackside termination order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in the process of establishing a communication session.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to terminate communication session.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to terminate the communication session while establishment is ongoing.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to passing RBC/RBC border
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in the process of establishing a communication session. Train is approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Train passes the RBC/RBC border with its min safe rear end while session establishment is ongoing.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Use stored RBC contact info for 'last known RBC' order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored valid RBC contact information. Trackside sends order with special RBC identity 'last known RBC' and a different telephone number.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order with special RBC identity and dummy phone number.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with 'last known RBC'.
steps.expected: OBU disregards the telephone number in the order and uses the stored RBC contact information to establish the session.

test_cases.title: Ignore 'last known RBC' order when no contact info stored
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has no stored RBC contact information. Trackside sends order with special RBC identity 'last known RBC'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order with special RBC identity.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with 'last known RBC'.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the order and does not attempt to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (setup in progress).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., driver selects Start or receives trackside order).

steps.action: Initiate a request to establish a communication session with RBC-A while the initial session setup with RBC-A is still in progress.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new, separate session establishment process with RBC-A. The existing setup process continues or is handled according to abort conditions, but no parallel/duplicate session is opened.

test_cases.title: Prevention of new session with same RBC when session is active
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., manual level change or trackside order).

steps.action: Trigger a condition that would normally require establishing a session with RBC-A (e.g., driver manually selects RBC-A contact info or a relevant mode change occurs).
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains the active one.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Order to establish a session with RBC-B (not an Accepting RBC in a transition context).

steps.action: Receive an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a Termination of Communication Session message to RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's behavior towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: Accepting RBC in transition does not terminate current session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A (Handing Over RBC) is established and active. An RBC transition order is received indicating RBC-B as the Accepting RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order with embedded order to establish session with Accepting RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU supports multiple simultaneous GSM-R sessions.

steps.action: Receive the RBC transition order containing the instruction to establish a session with Accepting RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT send a Termination of Communication Session message to RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's behavior towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of information validity in Sleeping mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is Forward.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group information valid for Reverse direction (opposite to train orientation) and valid for Forward direction.

steps.action: Receive information from a balise group that is valid only for the Reverse direction (opposite to the current train orientation).
steps.expected: The OBU ignores this information.

steps.action: Receive information from a balise group that is valid for the Forward direction (same as train orientation).
steps.expected: The OBU takes this information into account.

steps.action: Receive information from a balise group that is valid for both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU takes this information into account.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of information validity in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Forward.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group information valid for Reverse direction and valid for Forward direction.

steps.action: Receive information from a balise group that is valid only for the Reverse direction (opposite to the current train orientation).
steps.expected: The OBU ignores this information.

steps.action: Receive information from a balise group that is valid for the Forward direction (same as train orientation).
steps.expected: The OBU takes this information into account.

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence and immediate request on update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = Yes, Period = 10s. Last MA request sent 15 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition = Yes, Period = 5s.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately sends an MA request to the RBC because the time since the last request (15s) is greater than or equal to the new repetition period (5s).

steps.action: Wait for the next MA request trigger condition (e.g., timer elapse) after the immediate request.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the new 5-second repetition period for subsequent MA requests.

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence when no immediate trigger
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = Yes, Period = 10s. Last MA request sent 2 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition = Yes, Period = 5s.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT immediately send an MA request because the time since the last request (2s) is less than the new repetition period (5s).

steps.action: Wait until 5 seconds have passed since the last MA request.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No SvL defined while LOA is supervised
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero. SvL candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are present in the track description.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves within the LOA.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's internal state for Supervised Location (SvL) definition while the LOA is active.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define any SvL (end of overlap, Danger Point, or end of End Section) as the active Supervised Location.

steps.action: Receive a new MA that removes the LOA supervision (e.g., full MA received).
steps.expected: The OBU may now define an SvL based on the new MA and track description.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling speed restriction validity until new restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is received and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: New signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h.

steps.action: Wait for a period without receiving any new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Receive a new signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately replaces the 80 km/h restriction with the 60 km/h restriction.

test_cases.title: Level 1 to Level 2 transition: Signalling speed restriction remains valid
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active. OBU switches to Level 2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Level 2 MA not yet accepted.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h signalling related speed restriction.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 Movement Authority (MA).
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied (replaced by Level 2 supervision).

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a Maximum Train Speed of 200 km/h.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed approaches 200 km/h.

steps.action: Increase train speed towards the configured Maximum Train Speed of 200 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the 200 km/h value as a Static Speed Restriction and initiates braking if the speed exceeds this limit.

test_cases.title: Initial state: No speed restriction for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where no speed restriction has been computed from trackside data (initial state).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed increases.

steps.action: Increase train speed in the initial state before any trackside speed restriction is received.
steps.expected: The OBU does not constrain the train speed based on a permitted braking distance limit (i.e., no braking is triggered solely due to the 'no speed restriction' initial state logic for braking distance).

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state: No speed restriction for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is applying a speed restriction based on trackside data. Trackside orders the initial state to be resumed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside command to resume initial state.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU clears the current speed restriction and returns to the 'no speed restriction' state.

steps.action: Increase train speed after the state change.
steps.expected: The OBU does not constrain the train speed based on a permitted braking distance limit.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt after safe radio connection loss
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection was previously set up via GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the previous successful connection is identified as GSM-R in the OBU logs.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection by EURORADIO.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Monitor the radio system used for the reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The reconnection attempt is made using the GSM-R radio system (the same system used for the previous successful connection).

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempt uses FRMCS if previously used
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection was previously set up via FRMCS.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the previous successful connection is identified as FRMCS in the OBU logs.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection by EURORADIO.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Monitor the radio system used for the reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The reconnection attempt is made using the FRMCS radio system (the same system used for the previous successful connection).

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. First two reconnection attempts fail. Third attempt succeeds.
test_cases.assumptions: The session is not terminated and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the first reconnection attempt.

steps.action: Simulate failure of the first reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates a second reconnection attempt.

steps.action: Simulate failure of the second reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates a third reconnection attempt.

steps.action: Simulate success of the third reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The safe radio connection is established. The OBU stops repeating the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost. Reconnection attempts are ongoing.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. Reconnection attempts fail. Session termination condition is met (e.g., defined time expires without reconnection).
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for considering the session terminated is 30 seconds (assumed value for test).

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates reconnection attempts.

steps.action: Wait for the defined time to expire without successful reconnection.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the session as terminated.

steps.action: Monitor OBU behavior after session termination.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the reconnection attempts for the terminated session.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost. Reconnection attempts are ongoing. An RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. Reconnection attempts fail. Train position data indicating passage of the RIU termination location.
test_cases.assumptions: The RIU termination location is 100 meters ahead of the train's current position.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates reconnection attempts.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: OBU initiates termination upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established between the OBU and the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside termination order message.

steps.action: Send a termination order from the trackside (RBC) to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination process by sending a 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate termination without valid condition
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. No trackside order is received. No internal termination condition is met.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without sending any trackside order or triggering internal conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of communication session' message and the session remains active.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats termination message if no acknowledgement is received
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has sent a 'Termination of communication session' message. The trackside does not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is T_wait and the defined number of repetitions is N.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the first 'Termination of communication session' message without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message again.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after max repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating a session. It has already repeated the 'Termination of communication session' message N-1 times (where N is the defined number of repetitions). No acknowledgement has been received for any of the messages.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is T_wait and the defined number of repetitions is N.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the (N-1)th repetition without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message for the Nth time (the last allowed repetition).

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the Nth sending without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated and stops sending further messages.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and powered on. The OBU has a valid GSM-R Radio Network identity stored or configured.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the registration process for the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered after driver enters new identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and operational. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected. The current GSM-R Radio Network identity is different from the one to be entered.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and operational. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected. The OBU is not currently registered to the target GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Receive a Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network identity.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Default Radio Network type used when no memorised type exists
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. The OBU's non-volatile memory has been cleared or is in a state where no Radio Network type is memorised (simulating first power-up or post-system failure).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a default Radio Network type configured in its on-board settings.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board for its operations.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Only FRMCS is installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS. The FRMCS on-board is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has NOT elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal IS registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has NOT elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board IS registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. NO GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when selected single radio system not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver HAS elected to perform the mission with only one radio system (e.g., FRMCS). The selected FRMCS on-board is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (GSM-R only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Only GSM-R is installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is GSM-R. NO GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request for RIU when GSM-R not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. NO GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Indication status 'Connection Up' display
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where a safe radio connection can be established with an RBC.

steps.action: Initiate the process to establish a safe radio connection with the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the request to set up the connection.

steps.action: Wait for the safe radio connection to be successfully established.
steps.expected: The indication status changes to 'Connection Up'.

steps.action: Observe the driver display area E1.
steps.expected: The symbol ST03 is displayed in E1.

test_cases.title: Indication status 'No Connection' display
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where no safe radio connection is active and no setup is ongoing.

steps.action: Ensure the OBU is in the 'No Connection' indication status.
steps.expected: The system state is 'No Connection'.

steps.action: Observe the driver display area E1.
steps.expected: No symbol is displayed in E1.

test_cases.title: Indication status 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' display
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where a safe radio connection was previously active or setup was attempted.

steps.action: Trigger a condition that leads to the 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' status (e.g., connection loss with stopped requests).
steps.expected: The indication status changes to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

steps.action: Observe the driver display area E1.
steps.expected: The symbol ST04 is displayed in E1.

test_cases.title: Connection status timer start on first request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is ready to establish a session with an RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The internal state of the 'connection status' timer is observable or inferable from the indication status behavior.

steps.action: Trigger the first request to set up a safe radio connection with the RBC (e.g., via Start of Mission).
steps.expected: The OBU sends the first request.

steps.action: Verify the 'connection status' timer state immediately after the request is sent.
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer is started (ongoing).

test_cases.title: Connection status timer start on maintenance request
test_cases.preconditions: A safe radio connection is active, and the OBU is in a state where it may need to re-establish or maintain the connection (e.g., after a temporary loss or specific protocol event requiring a new setup request).
test_cases.assumptions: The scenario simulates a situation where a request to set up a safe radio connection is sent for maintenance purposes as per §3.5.4.2 or §3.5.4.4.

steps.action: Trigger a request to set up a safe radio connection for maintaining the session.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the request.

steps.action: Verify the 'connection status' timer state immediately after the request is sent.
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer is started (ongoing).

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Up
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the 'No Connection' indication status.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection with the RBC.
steps.expected: The condition [4] (safe radio connection is set-up) is met.

steps.action: Observe the indication status.
steps.expected: The status transitions from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to No Connection
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the 'Connection Up' indication status.

steps.action: Release the safe radio connection with the RBC.
steps.expected: The condition [5] (safe radio connection is released) is met.

steps.action: Observe the indication status.
steps.expected: The status transitions from 'Connection Up' to 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the 'Connection Up' indication status.

steps.action: Cause the safe radio connection to be lost and ensure requests to set up the connection are stopped for a reason other than successful set-up.
steps.expected: The condition [6] (connection lost AND requests stopped) is met.

steps.action: Observe the indication status.
steps.expected: The status transitions from 'Connection Up' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the 'No Connection' indication status, and a Start of Mission procedure is ongoing.

steps.action: Ensure the final attempt to set up the safe radio connection fails.
steps.expected: The condition [1] (Start of Mission ongoing AND final attempt failed) is met.

steps.action: Observe the indication status.
steps.expected: The status transitions from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Lost/Set-Up failed to No Connection
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' indication status, and no Start of Mission procedure is ongoing.

steps.action: Ensure requests to set up a safe radio connection are stopped for a reason other than successful set-up.
steps.expected: The condition [3] (no Start of Mission AND requests stopped) is met.

steps.action: Observe the indication status.
steps.expected: The status transitions from 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' to 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Lost/Set-Up failed to Connection Up
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' indication status.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection with the RBC.
steps.expected: The condition [4] (safe radio connection is set-up) is met.

steps.action: Observe the indication status.
steps.expected: The status transitions from 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' to 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: RIU indication reflects current infill area
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has safe radio connections with multiple Radio Infill Units (RIUs).
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving through different infill areas, and the 'current infill area' is determined by the train's position.

steps.action: Position the train in Infill Area A, where a safe radio connection with RIU-A is active.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates the status of the connection with RIU-A.

steps.action: Move the train into Infill Area B, where a safe radio connection with RIU-B is active.
steps.expected: The OBU switches the indication to reflect the status of the connection with RIU-B.

test_cases.title: Revalidation of train position upon passing LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. The train position status is 'invalid'. An invalid train position is stored on-board.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train passes an LRBG.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status and stored position.
steps.expected: The train position status is 'invalid' and an invalid position is stored.

steps.action: Move the train to pass an LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on-board. The previously stored invalid train position is deleted.

test_cases.title: Revalidation of train position upon passing ORBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. The train position status is 'unknown'. No valid train position is stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train passes an ORBG.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status.
steps.expected: The train position status is 'unknown'.

steps.action: Move the train to pass an ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on-board.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by active cab
test_cases.preconditions: The train consists of two cabs (Cab A and Cab B). Cab A is active. The train is moving in the direction of Cab A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Active cab: Cab A.

steps.action: Check the train orientation defined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the front of the train as the side of Cab A (the active cab).

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The train consists of two cabs (Cab A and Cab B). Cab B was the last active cab. Currently, no cab is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Active cab: None. Last active cab: Cab B.

steps.action: Check the train orientation defined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation based on the last active cab (Cab B).

test_cases.title: Use of estimated front end for location based supervision
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a mode where location based information is supervised (e.g., Full Supervision). The estimated front end position is distinct from the max safe front end and min safe rear end.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information requiring supervision (e.g., a speed restriction or MA limit) is present.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific function being tested does not have an explicit exception in SUBSET-026 specifying a different reference (like max safe front end for End Section timer).

steps.action: Trigger a supervision check for a location based event that uses the default reference.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the estimated front end position as the train position reference for the supervision calculation.

test_cases.title: Use of specified reference for End Section timer
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching the End Section of a Movement Authority. The End Section timer start location is defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position such that the max safe front end is closer to the End Section timer start location than the estimated front end.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 specifies max safe front end for End Section timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location, while the estimated front end has not yet passed it.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts (or the relevant supervision logic triggers) based on the max safe front end position, not the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Use of specified reference for RBC border crossing
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching an RBC/RBC border. The border location is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position such that the min safe rear end is closer to the RBC border than the estimated front end.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 specifies min safe rear end for passing an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Move the train such that the min safe rear end passes the RBC/RBC border, while the estimated front end has not yet passed it.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the passing of the RBC/RBC border based on the min safe rear end position.

test_cases.title: OBU reports position using the last passed LRBG compliant balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving in a section with linked balise groups. The OBU has passed balise group BG1 (LRBG compliant) and is currently between BG1 and BG2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG1 data (linked, consistent).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a mode that allows position reporting to the RBC.

steps.action: The train passes the LRBG compliant balise group BG1.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies BG1 as the current LRBGONB.

steps.action: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG1 as the LRBG.

test_cases.title: OBU accepts trackside information referring to a recently reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has reported positions for the last 8 LRBG compliant balise groups (BG1 to BG8) to the RBC. The current LRBGONB is BG8.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message containing location data referred to BG5.
test_cases.assumptions: BG5 is within the last 8 reported LRBGs.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message with location data referred to BG5.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and processes the location data relative to BG5.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects trackside information referring to an LRBG outside the minimum window
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has reported positions for the last 8 LRBG compliant balise groups (BG1 to BG8). BG0 was reported before BG1 and is no longer in the last 8 reported LRBGs.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message containing location data referred to BG0.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to accept is 8 as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: The RBC sends a message with location data referred to BG0.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the message or ignores the location data as it refers to an LRBG outside the accepted window.

test_cases.title: OBU uses LRBG identifier 'unknown' when position is referred to an unlinked balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The train has passed a balise group marked as unlinked. No LRBG compliant balise group has been passed since then.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data marked as unlinked.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a state where it must report position but lacks a valid LRBGONB.

steps.action: The OBU attempts to report train position to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the LRBG identifier as 'unknown'.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information valid for the opposite direction
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving in the nominal direction. The OBU is in a mode where it processes trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside message (e.g., from a balise or radio) containing valid data for the reverse direction only.

steps.action: Transmit a message to the OBU that is explicitly marked as valid for the reverse direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the message. No state change or application of the data occurs.

steps.action: Transmit a message to the OBU that is explicitly marked as valid for the nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts and processes the message according to its content.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation is unknown but accepts both-direction data
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group).
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. A message valid for one direction only (nominal). 2. A message valid for both directions.

steps.action: Transmit a message valid for one direction only (nominal) to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

steps.action: Transmit a message valid for both directions to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and accepts the data.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of continuous profile data with standard incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received profile data. The train is moving in the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data structure with: Value(1) = Speed Limit A, Distance(1) = 100m; Value(2) = Speed Limit B, Distance(2) = 200m; Value(3) = Speed Limit C, Distance(3) = 0m (End of Profile).

steps.action: Transmit the continuous profile data structure to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Value(1) as valid for the first 100m (using previously received data for the start). Value(2) is valid for the next 200m. Value(3) is valid for the remaining distance.

steps.action: Verify the applied speed limits at distances 50m, 150m, and 350m from the reference point.
steps.expected: At 50m, Speed Limit A is applied. At 150m, Speed Limit B is applied. At 350m, Speed Limit C is applied.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data with zero distance increment
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is processing continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data structure where Distance(n+1) is 0 for a specific value n.

steps.action: Transmit a profile where Value(1) is followed by Distance(1)=100m, and Value(2) is followed by Distance(2)=0m.
steps.expected: The OBU takes Value(2) into account. The zero distance does not cause the value to be ignored or cause an error.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of location data with unsigned incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data structure: Value(1) = Location Info A, Distance(1) = 50m; Value(2) = Location Info B, Distance(2) = 150m.

steps.action: Transmit the location data structure to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance(1) as the distance from the previous reference to Value(1). Value(1) is valid for the first 50m. Value(2) is valid for the next 150m.

steps.action: Verify the location data applied at 25m and 100m.
steps.expected: At 25m, Location Info A is active. At 100m, Location Info B is active.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of non-continuous profile data with overlapping elements
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is processing non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data: Element 1 (Value A, Length 100m), Distance(1) = 0m; Element 2 (Value B, Length 50m), Distance(2) = 50m.

steps.action: Transmit the non-continuous profile data structure.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Element 1 starting at the reference point. Element 2 starts at 50m (incremental distance from Element 1 start). The OBU accepts that Element 2 overlaps with Element 1 (since 50m < 100m).

steps.action: Verify the data applied at 75m.
steps.expected: Both Element 1 and Element 2 are considered valid at 75m, or the specific priority rule for overlapping non-continuous data is applied as per system design (typically the most restrictive or latest, but the requirement only states it shall accept overlap). The OBU does not reject the data due to overlap.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of linking information distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is processing linking information from a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information: Distance(1) = 100m to Balise Group A; Distance(2) = 200m to Balise Group B; Value(1) = Linking Data A; Value(2) = Linking Data B.

steps.action: Transmit the linking information structure to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance(1) as the distance to the first announced balise group (A). Distance(2) is interpreted as the distance between Balise Group A and Balise Group B.

steps.action: Verify the expected position of Balise Group B.
steps.expected: The OBU expects Balise Group B to be at 100m + 200m = 300m from the current reference point.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking information containing location accuracy for a specific balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with location accuracy value X for Balise Group A.

steps.action: Receive linking information specifying location accuracy X for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: OBU stores location accuracy X for Balise Group A.

steps.action: Pass Balise Group A so it becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: OBU uses location accuracy X for Balise Group A in position calculations.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group B. A National Value Y is applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group B with no prior location accuracy determination. National Value Y configured.

steps.action: Pass Balise Group B so it becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: OBU uses National Value Y as the location accuracy for Balise Group B.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group C. No National Value is applicable. Default Value Z is configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group C with no prior location accuracy determination. Default Value Z configured.

steps.action: Pass Balise Group C so it becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: OBU uses Default Value Z as the location accuracy for Balise Group C.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated upon new linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined location accuracy X for Balise Group A from initial linking information. Balise Group A is the current LRBG.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information containing a different location accuracy value W for Balise Group A.

steps.action: Receive new linking information specifying location accuracy W for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: OBU retains location accuracy X for Balise Group A and does not update it to W.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined location accuracy X for Balise Group A. Linking consistency checking is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Condition causing linking consistency checking to stop.

steps.action: Trigger a condition that stops linking consistency checking.
steps.expected: OBU retains location accuracy X for Balise Group A.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when new National Values become applicable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined location accuracy X for Balise Group A. A new National Value Y becomes applicable for the current area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Change in area or configuration making National Value Y applicable.

steps.action: Apply the change that makes National Value Y applicable.
steps.expected: OBU retains location accuracy X for Balise Group A and does not switch to Y.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with min and max safe front ends
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Train is moving. Reference balise group has location accuracy L. Odometer over-reading amount is O and under-reading amount is U. No consist-length-related situation applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position E. Location accuracy L. Over-reading O. Under-reading U.
test_cases.assumptions: Consist length uncertainty is not applicable in this scenario.

steps.action: Calculate the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: Min safe front end is calculated as E - (L + U). Max safe front end is calculated as E + (L + O).

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is being checked. Balise Group A is the reference of linking information. Balise Group B is announced in linking information and is received after A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of received balise groups: A, then B.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group A (reference of linking info).
steps.expected: SOLR is set to Balise Group A.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group B (announced in linking info).
steps.expected: SOLR is updated to Balise Group B.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not being checked. Balise Group C is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Received balise group C.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group C.
steps.expected: SOLR is set to Balise Group C.

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored linking information. New linking information is received that triggers a replacement rule.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information requiring replacement per §3.7.3.1 m).

steps.action: Receive new linking information.
steps.expected: OBU applies the linking replacement rule first, then updates the SOLR based on the new linking information.

test_cases.title: Relocation before replacement for non-linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has location based information referred to a balise group other than the current SOLR. New information of a type requiring replacement is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: New location based information requiring replacement per §3.7.3.1.

steps.action: Receive new location based information.
steps.expected: OBU relocates the existing information to the SOLR before applying the replacement rule for the new information.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into location items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives location based information (e.g., EOA) that defines min, estimated, and max values.
test_cases.test_inputs: EOA message with min, estimated, and max location values.

steps.action: Process the received EOA message.
steps.expected: OBU creates three location items: 'min', 'estimated', and 'max', each referred to the distance from the reference balise group.

steps.action: Apply a clause associated with the 'min' location item type per Table 2a.
steps.expected: The clause is applied using the 'min' location item value.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to SOLR using linking distance
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group A is the current SOLR. Location item L is referred to Balise Group B. Linking distance between B and A is known and available. No repositioning balise group is encountered between B and A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location item L with distance D_L from B. Linking distance D_link between B and A.

steps.action: Evaluate location item L while Balise Group A is the SOLR.
steps.expected: OBU relocates L to SOLR A by subtracting D_link from D_L. The new distance is D_L - D_link.

test_cases.title: Relocation of min location item with location accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group A is the current SOLR. Location item L_min is referred to Balise Group B. The last relocation of L_min was performed per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than B. Linking distance between B and A is known. Location accuracy of B is L_acc.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location item L_min with distance D_min from B. Linking distance D_link between B and A. Location accuracy L_acc.

steps.action: Evaluate location item L_min while Balise Group A is the SOLR.
steps.expected: OBU relocates L_min to SOLR A by subtracting (D_link - 2 * L_acc) from D_min. The new distance is D_min - (D_link - 2 * L_acc).

test_cases.title: Relocation using travelled distance when linking is not available
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group A is the current SOLR. Location item L_est is referred to Balise Group B. Linking distance between B and A is not available. Estimated front end position against B is P_B. Estimated front end position against A is P_A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location item L_est with distance D_est from B. P_B and P_A values.

steps.action: Evaluate location item L_est while Balise Group A is the SOLR.
steps.expected: OBU relocates L_est to SOLR A by subtracting (P_B - P_A) from D_est. The new distance is D_est - (P_B - P_A).

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving and a communication session with the RBC is established. Position report parameters are configured.

steps.action: Bring the train to a complete standstill.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: The train is at standstill and a communication session with the RBC is established.

steps.action: Start the train to move from standstill.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon mode change
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a valid operational mode (e.g., Full Supervision) and a communication session with the RBC is established.

steps.action: Change the train mode (e.g., to Shunting or Standby).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon level change
test_cases.preconditions: The train is operating in Level 2 and a communication session with the RBC is established.

steps.action: Trigger a level change (e.g., to Level 1 or NTC).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon successful session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is not currently connected to an RBC.

steps.action: Establish a communication session with the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent when passing LRBG without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: No position report parameters are stored on-board. The train is moving towards an LRBG compliant balise group.

steps.action: Pass the LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon driver confirmation of train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: The train is at standstill. The driver is able to confirm train integrity.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon detection of loss of train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: The train integrity is currently confirmed. A condition causing loss of integrity is simulated.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of train integrity (e.g., via external source or internal detection).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon crossing RBC/RBC border with min safe rear end
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Move the train such that its min safe rear end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon crossing RBC/RBC border with max safe front end
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon detection of error defined in 3.16.4
test_cases.preconditions: The system is operational.
test_cases.assumptions: An error condition defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.4 can be injected.

steps.action: Inject an error as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.4.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status reported as 'No integrity information' initially
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session with the RBC is successfully established.

steps.action: Observe the first position report sent to the RBC after session establishment.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is 'No integrity information' and no confirmed train length is included.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status reported as 'Confirmed by driver' with length
test_cases.preconditions: The train is at standstill. Valid Train Data is available and acknowledged. The driver confirms train integrity.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the integrity status to 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by leaving standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status reported as 'Confirmed by external source' with length
test_cases.preconditions: The train is at standstill. Valid Train Data is available. An external source sends 'Train integrity confirmed'.

steps.action: Receive 'Train integrity confirmed' from an external source.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the integrity status to 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status reported as 'Lost' without length
test_cases.preconditions: The train integrity is currently confirmed (by driver or external source).

steps.action: Simulate a loss of train integrity (e.g., Train Data becomes invalid or external source reports loss).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the integrity status to 'Lost'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Lost' and does NOT include confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by driver' is valid
test_cases.preconditions: The current integrity status is 'No integrity information'. The train is at standstill. Valid Train Data is available and acknowledged.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The integrity status transitions to 'Confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'Lost' is valid
test_cases.preconditions: The current integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Simulate a condition that causes loss of integrity (e.g., Train Data status changes to invalid).
steps.expected: The integrity status transitions to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by external source' to 'Lost' is valid
test_cases.preconditions: The current integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Simulate a condition that causes loss of integrity (e.g., Train Data status changes to invalid).
steps.expected: The integrity status transitions to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Invalid transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Lost' is prevented
test_cases.preconditions: The current integrity status is 'No integrity information'.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is designed to only allow transitions defined in Table 2b.

steps.action: Attempt to force a transition to 'Lost' without first confirming integrity (e.g., by simulating an integrity loss event while in 'No integrity information' state).
steps.expected: The integrity status remains 'No integrity information' or transitions to a valid state as per Table 2b, but does not directly become 'Lost' if that transition is not defined from 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Confirmed train length calculation accuracy
test_cases.preconditions: The train integrity is confirmed by the driver. The train position is valid and referred to an LRBG. The train length is known.
test_cases.assumptions: The min safe rear end position at the time of last known integrity and the current estimated front end position are known for verification.

steps.action: Trigger a position report after confirming train integrity.
steps.expected: The confirmed train length in the report equals the distance between the min safe rear end at the time the train was last known to be integer and the estimated position of the train front at the time of the report.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has valid geographical position information stored and the display is currently off.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is not displayed on the HMI.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not visible on the display.

steps.action: The driver requests the geographical position display.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the train's estimated front end in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stop geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position is currently displayed on the HMI.

steps.action: The driver requests to stop the geographical position display.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a valid geographical reference location (track kilometre reference) and the train has moved a known distance from this reference.
test_cases.test_inputs: A known distance travelled from the geographical reference location (e.g., 100 meters).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's internal distance measurement is accurate for the test scenario.

steps.action: Record the track kilometre value at the geographical reference location.
steps.expected: The reference track kilometre value is noted.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance (e.g., 100 meters) from the reference location in the direction of increasing track kilometre.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position.

steps.action: Request the geographical position display.
steps.expected: The displayed track kilometre value is equal to the reference value plus the distance travelled (e.g., Reference + 100m).

test_cases.title: Calculation of remaining distance for Roll Away Protection upon supervision start

steps.action: Initiate the supervision of the Roll Away distance (e.g., by entering the relevant mode or condition).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and displays the remaining distance to be travelled as equal to the National/Default Value for Roll Away distance.

steps.action: Move the train forward by a known distance (e.g., 2 m) within the supervised limit.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to be travelled to (National/Default Value - 2 m).

test_cases.title: Calculation of remaining distance for Post Trip reversing upon supervision start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Post Trip mode. The train is stationary.

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the calculated remaining distance for reversing in Post Trip mode.

steps.action: Trigger the supervision of the reversing distance in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and displays the remaining distance to be travelled as equal to the National/Default Value for Post Trip reversing.

test_cases.title: Calculation of remaining distance for Staff Responsible mode upon entry
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode prior to Staff Responsible (e.g., Full Supervision). The train is stationary.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for maximum permitted distance to run in Staff Responsible mode (e.g., 1000 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the calculated remaining distance for Staff Responsible mode.

steps.action: Transition the OBU into Staff Responsible mode.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and displays the remaining distance to be travelled as equal to the National/Default Value for Staff Responsible mode.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Roll Away distance using estimated distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: Roll Away Protection supervision is active. The train is stationary at the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for Roll Away distance (e.g., 10 m). Odometer accuracy is set to a known value.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU uses the estimated distance travelled (raw odometer count) for this calculation as per §3.6.7.2.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 3 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as (10 m - 3 m) = 7 m, based on the estimated distance travelled away from the start location.

steps.action: Move the train forward by an additional 4 m (total 7 m).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as (10 m - 7 m) = 3 m.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Standstill distance using estimated distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: Standstill supervision is active. The train is stationary.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for Standstill distance (e.g., 5 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU uses the estimated distance travelled for this calculation.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 2 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as (5 m - 2 m) = 3 m.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position calculation for Staff Responsible distance with odometer under-reading
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. The maximum permitted distance is determined by a National Value (e.g., 1000 m). The odometer has a known under-reading amount (e.g., 5 m) since the function was activated.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR Distance: 1000 m. Odometer under-reading: 5 m. Distance travelled (estimated): 100 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the max safe front end position as: Supervised Distance - Estimated Distance Travelled - Odometer Under-reading.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 100 m (estimated).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the max safe front end position as: 1000 m - 100 m - 5 m = 895 m.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position calculation for Staff Responsible distance with odometer over-reading
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. The maximum permitted distance is determined by a National Value (e.g., 1000 m). The odometer has a known over-reading amount (e.g., 5 m) since the function was activated.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR Distance: 1000 m. Odometer over-reading: 5 m. Distance travelled (estimated): 100 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the min safe front end position as: Supervised Distance - Estimated Distance Travelled + Odometer Over-reading.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 100 m (estimated).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the min safe front end position as: 1000 m - 100 m + 5 m = 905 m.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position calculation for zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode after Override was triggered without a valid train position. The former EOA/LOA is set to a zero distance from the virtual train front position.
test_cases.test_inputs: Former EOA/LOA distance: 0 m. Odometer under-reading: 2 m. Distance travelled (estimated): 10 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the max safe front end position as: Supervised Distance (0 m) - Estimated Distance Travelled - Odometer Under-reading.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 10 m (estimated).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the max safe front end position as: 0 m - 10 m - 2 m = -12 m. This indicates the train has passed the max safe front end position.

test_cases.title: Re-start of supervision for Staff Responsible distance upon RBC update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. The current SR distance is 1000 m. The train has moved 100 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: New SR distance from RBC: 500 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU deletes the previous virtual train position and creates a new one as per §3.6.7.5.

steps.action: Receive a new SR distance of 500 m from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the previous virtual train position and starts a new supervision. The remaining distance is calculated based on the new distance (500 m) and the current estimated distance travelled from the new start location (which is the current position).

test_cases.title: MA rejection due to incomplete SSP/gradient coverage (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. The train is moving or stationary. The on-board SSP and gradient data cover only a portion of the track ahead, ending before the Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.test_inputs: A Movement Authority (MA) message from RBC where the Supervised Location (SvL) is beyond the end of the currently available on-board SSP/gradient data. The MA is a non-infill MA.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for a non-infill MA is defined as at least from the estimated front end of the train to the supervised location.

steps.action: Send a new MA from the RBC to the OBU where the SSP and gradient data provided (or already on-board) do not cover the full length from the estimated train front end to the MA's Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA and the associated mode profile (if any). The previous MA remains valid. The OBU does not update its supervision limits based on the new MA.

test_cases.title: MA rejection due to incomplete SSP/gradient coverage (Infill)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. An infill MA is being processed. The on-board SSP and gradient data do not cover the full length from the infill location reference to the Supervised Location.
test_cases.test_inputs: An Infill Movement Authority (MA) message from RBC where the SSP and gradient data do not cover the full length from the infill location reference to the MA's Supervised Location.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for an infill MA is defined as at least from the infill location reference to the supervised location.

steps.action: Send an Infill MA from the RBC to the OBU where the SSP and gradient data do not cover the full length from the infill location reference to the MA's Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the Infill MA and the associated mode profile (if any). The previous MA remains valid.

test_cases.title: MA rejection due to incomplete SSP/gradient coverage (Supervised Manoeuvre, Opposite Orientation)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation is active. The MA's validity direction is opposite to the current train orientation.
test_cases.test_inputs: An MA that is part of a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction opposite to the current train orientation. The SSP and gradient data do not cover the full length from the estimated front end of the train (derived from the new orientation) to the Supervised Location.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for this case is defined as at least from the estimated front end of the train derived from the new train orientation to the supervised location.

steps.action: Send the MA from the RBC to the OBU. Ensure the SSP and gradient data do not cover the full length from the estimated front end (based on new orientation) to the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA and the associated mode profile (if any). The previous MA remains valid.

test_cases.title: MA acceptance with complete SSP/gradient coverage
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. The on-board SSP and gradient data cover the full length of the new MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Movement Authority (MA) message from RBC where the SSP and gradient data cover the full length from the estimated train front end to the MA's Supervised Location.

steps.action: Send a new MA from the RBC to the OBU where the SSP and gradient data cover the full length from the estimated train front end to the MA's Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the MA and the associated mode profile (if any). The OBU updates its supervision limits based on the new MA.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Static Speed Profile from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Stored Static Speed Profile information exists for a section ahead of the train.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track description message containing Static Speed Profile information with a start location within the stored range.

steps.action: Send a new track description message containing Static Speed Profile information to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the stored Static Speed Profile information from the start location of the new information. The information before the start location remains unchanged, and the information after is updated according to the new profile.

test_cases.title: Complete replacement of Route Suitability Loading Gauge

test_cases.title: MA request includes all applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2 and connected to the RBC. The MA request parameters are configured to allow repetition.
test_cases.test_inputs: A scenario where two MA request reasons are simultaneously applicable (e.g., 'Start' selected by driver and 'Track description deletion').
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC is configured to log the content of received MA requests for verification.

steps.action: Trigger the first MA request reason (e.g., driver selects 'Start').
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC containing the reason 'Start selected by driver'.

steps.action: Trigger the second MA request reason (e.g., delete a part of the track description not excluded by A.3.4 exceptions) while the first reason is still applicable.
steps.expected: A new MA request is sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the latest MA request received by the RBC.
steps.expected: The request contains both reasons: 'Start selected by driver' and 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. A perturbation location is defined. The MA request parameters for the perturbation location criterion are received from the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed and position such that the train front passes the calculated triggering location $d_{MAR}$.

steps.action: Move the train such that the train front approaches the calculated triggering location $d_{MAR}$.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent while the train front is before $d_{MAR}$.

steps.action: Move the train such that the train front passes the location $d_{MAR}$.
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the reason in the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The reason is 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. A Section timer is active. The MA request parameters for the Section timer criterion are received from the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time progression such that the defined time before the Section timer expiration is reached.
test_cases.assumptions: The Section timer is running and will expire in the future. The RBC logs MA requests.

steps.action: Wait until the time remaining on the Section timer is greater than the defined triggering time.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent due to the Section timer criterion.

steps.action: Wait until the time remaining on the Section timer equals the defined triggering time.
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the reason in the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The reason is 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached'.
