steps.action: Wait until the time remaining on the LOA speed timer equals the defined triggering time.
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the reason in the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The reason is 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached'.

test_cases.title: Replacement of MA data from RBC (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode and has a valid MA stored from a previous balise group.

steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA (sections, speeds, timers) has been completely replaced by the data from the new RBC MA.

test_cases.title: Replacement of MA data from Main Signal Balise (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in FS mode and has a valid MA stored. The train approaches a main signal with a balise group.

steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA has been completely replaced by the data from the new balise MA.

test_cases.title: Partial replacement of MA data from Infill

steps.action: Receive the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data for sections before the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data for sections before the next main signal remains unchanged from the previous MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data for sections beyond the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data for sections beyond the next main signal has been replaced by the data from the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Start of new MA section at infill location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in FS mode. The train is approaching the next main signal.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message referencing the balise group at the next main signal.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Check the start location of the first section of the new MA structure.
steps.expected: The new MA section starts at the infill location reference, which is the balise group at the next main signal.

test_cases.title: MA Shortening when SvL is closer than LOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA). The train is moving within the LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA defining a Supervised Location (SvL) that is closer to the train than the current LOA end.

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining a closer SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Check the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: Location-based information beyond the new SvL, as listed in Appendix A.3.4, is deleted.

test_cases.title: MA Shortening when SvL is farther than LOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA). The train is moving within the LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA defining a Supervised Location (SvL) that is farther from the train than the current LOA end.

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining a farther SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as an MA shortening (regardless of SvL location relative to LOA).

steps.action: Check the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: Location-based information beyond the new SvL, as listed in Appendix A.3.4, is deleted.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information is not MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in FS mode with a valid MA. Linking information indicates a following balise group with repositioning info.
test_cases.test_inputs: Repositioning information received from a balise group.

steps.action: Receive repositioning information.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the length of the current MA section.

steps.action: Check if the OBU triggers MA shortening procedures.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat this as an MA shortening; no location-based information is deleted due to shortening.

test_cases.title: New MA with LOA is not MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in FS mode with a valid MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA that ends with a Limit of Authority (LOA).

steps.action: Receive the new MA ending with an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check if the OBU triggers MA shortening procedures.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat this as an MA shortening; no location-based information is deleted due to shortening.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of MA shortening when train is in rear of ISL
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2 and has a valid current MA with an EOA/LOA. The train front end position is known and is in rear of the Indication Supervision Limit (ISL) of a proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a 'Request to shorten MA' message containing a proposed shortened MA with an EOA closer to the train than the current EOA/LOA, including a mode profile and a list of balise groups for SH area.

steps.action: Send the 'Request to shorten MA' message from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the request. The proposed shortened MA, its mode profile, and the list of balise groups for SH area are stored as the new MA.

steps.action: Check the communication interface for the OBU's response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement or decision message to the RBC indicating that the request was accepted.

test_cases.title: Rejection of MA shortening when train is in advance of ISL
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2 and has a valid current MA with an EOA/LOA, a mode profile, and a list of balise groups for SH area. The train front end position is known and is in advance of the Indication Supervision Limit (ISL) of a proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a 'Request to shorten MA' message containing a proposed shortened MA with an EOA closer to the train than the current EOA/LOA, including a mode profile and a list of balise groups for SH area.

steps.action: Send the 'Request to shorten MA' message from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request. The previously received MA, mode profile, and list of balise groups for SH area remain valid and unchanged.

steps.action: Check the communication interface for the OBU's response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a decision message to the RBC indicating that the request was rejected.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of MA shortening without optional data
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2 and has a valid current MA. The train front end position is in rear of the Indication Supervision Limit (ISL) of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a 'Request to shorten MA' message containing a proposed shortened MA with an EOA closer to the train, but without a mode profile and without a list of balise groups for SH area.

steps.action: Send the 'Request to shorten MA' message from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the request. The proposed shortened MA is stored as the new MA. No mode profile or SH-area balise group list is added or retained from the request.

steps.action: Check the communication interface for the OBU's response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a decision message to the RBC indicating that the request was accepted.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores infill announcement for unsupported medium
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is operating in Level 1 and is not equipped with the specific infill transmission medium (e.g., Radio Infill Unit capability disabled or hardware absent). The OBU has previously received valid Movement Authority (MA) and location-based information from a main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: An announcement balise group requesting an infill transmission medium not supported by the OBU (e.g., requesting Radio Infill when OBU has no RIU).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's configuration correctly reflects the absence of the requested infill medium.

steps.action: The train passes the announcement balise group that requests an infill transmission medium not equipped on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the announcement information. No error related to missing infill medium is raised. The OBU continues to operate based on the previously received MA and location information.

steps.action: The train continues to move within the previously received Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The OBU maintains the current speed profile and movement authority without interruption or degradation due to the ignored announcement.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores loop infill after reading next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 and has received an order to read infill information from a loop. The next main signal balise group is identified in the order.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill message, Balise group data for the next main signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The loop infill unit continues to transmit valid infill data after the OBU passes the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU reading the next main signal balise group indicated in the infill order.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the reading of the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit a new infill information message from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information and does not update its movement authority or location data based on this message.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores loop infill after detecting missed next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 and has received an order to read infill information from a loop. The next main signal balise group is identified in the order.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill message, Simulation of missed balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's detection logic for a missed balise group is functional and triggers the 'missed' state.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU detecting that the next main signal balise group was missed (e.g., by passing the expected location without reading the balise).
steps.expected: The OBU registers the detection of the missed main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit a new infill information message from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information and does not update its movement authority or location data based on this message.

test_cases.title: Order ignored when GSM-R is not installed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured without a GSM-R radio system. The train is in Level 1.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with a specific RIU.

steps.action: The train reads a balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with a Radio Infill Unit.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order. No communication session is established with the RIU.

test_cases.title: Session switch upon reaching location via balise order
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has an active communication session with RIU-A. The train is in Level 1 with GSM-R installed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group containing an order to establish a session with RIU-B, specifying a location ahead of the current position.

steps.action: The train reads the balise group with the order for RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU maintains the session with RIU-A until the specified location is reached.

steps.action: The train reaches the location specified in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the session with RIU-A and establishes a new session with RIU-B.

test_cases.title: Order ignored in degraded single-session mode
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a degraded situation where it can handle only one GSM-R communication session. An active session exists with RIU-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order received via RIU-A to establish a session with RIU-B.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order via the active RIU-A session to establish a new session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order. The session with RIU-A is maintained, and no session with RIU-B is established.

test_cases.title: Notification to RIU upon entering infill area
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session with an RIU is established. The train is approaching the location specified in the balise order.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement passing the specified location.

steps.action: The train passes the location indicated in the balise group order (entry into the infill area).
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the radio infill unit immediately.

test_cases.title: Notification to RIU upon reading next main signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an infill area and has informed the RIU of entry. The next main signal balise group is ahead.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement reading the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: The train reads the next main signal balise group indicated in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the radio infill unit immediately.

test_cases.title: Notification to RIU upon detecting missed balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an infill area. The next main signal balise group is expected but not read (simulated miss).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement passing the expected location of the next main signal balise group without reading it.

steps.action: The OBU detects that the next main signal balise group was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the radio infill unit immediately.

test_cases.title: Content of information sent to RIU
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is about to send information to the RIU (e.g., upon entering the infill area).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger event for sending information (passing location).

steps.action: The OBU sends information to the radio infill unit.
steps.expected: The message contains the train identity (ETCS-ID), a position report, the identifier of the next main signal balise group, and a time stamp.

test_cases.title: Consistency check of valid radio infill data
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session with an RIU is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid radio infill data conforming to SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 and §3.16.3.3.

steps.action: The OBU receives valid radio infill data from the RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data and processes it without error.

test_cases.title: Consistency check of invalid radio infill data
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session with an RIU is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio infill data with inconsistencies (e.g., invalid checksum or logical error) violating SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 or §3.16.3.3.

steps.action: The OBU receives inconsistent radio infill data from the RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the inconsistency and rejects the data according to the specified principles.

test_cases.title: Ignoring infill data after reading next main signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has read the next main signal balise group indicated in the order.
test_cases.test_inputs: Further radio infill information related to that specific balise group sent by the RIU.

steps.action: The RIU sends further infill information related to the already read next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores this information.

test_cases.title: Ignoring infill data after detecting missed balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has detected that the next main signal balise group was missed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Further radio infill information related to that specific balise group sent by the RIU.

steps.action: The RIU sends further infill information related to the missed next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores this information.

test_cases.title: Termination of session via trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session with an RIU exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order to terminate the session received from a balise group or RIU.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order from trackside to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the RIU.

test_cases.title: Termination of session when leaving Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session with an RIU exists. The train is in Level 1.
test_cases.test_inputs: Transition to a different operational level (e.g., Level 2 or Level 0).

steps.action: The OBU leaves Level 1 (e.g., enters Level 2).
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the RIU.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of a valid emergency message
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive and process emergency messages (e.g., Level 2 communication session established).
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid emergency message (e.g., Unconditional Emergency Stop) with a unique identification number (NID_EM).

steps.action: Send an emergency message to the OBU containing a specific identification number (NID_EM).
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's outgoing radio messages.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message (e.g., Message 147: Acknowledgement of Emergency Stop) that contains the same identification number (NID_EM) as the received emergency message.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of a repeated emergency message with the same identifier
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has already received and acknowledged an emergency message with a specific identification number (NID_EM).
test_cases.test_inputs: A repeated emergency message with the same identification number (NID_EM) as the previous one.

steps.action: Send a second emergency message to the OBU with the same identification number (NID_EM) as the first one.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's outgoing radio messages.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message that contains the same identification number (NID_EM).

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of an emergency message with a different identifier
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive and process emergency messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two distinct emergency messages with different identification numbers (NID_EM_1 and NID_EM_2).

steps.action: Send the first emergency message with identification number NID_EM_1 to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message containing NID_EM_1.

steps.action: Send the second emergency message with identification number NID_EM_2 to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message containing NID_EM_2.

test_cases.title: Rejection of new MA after accepted Conditional Emergency Stop
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it can accept a Conditional Emergency Stop message. The train has not passed the stop location specified in the message.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid Conditional Emergency Stop message with a stop location ahead of the train's min safe front end. A valid new Movement Authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Send a Conditional Emergency Stop message to the OBU with a stop location ahead of the train.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and updates the EOA/SvL accordingly (e.g., sets EOA to the stop location with no release speed).

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA. The current EOA/SvL defined by the emergency stop remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Rejection of new MA after accepted Unconditional Emergency Stop
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it can accept an Unconditional Emergency Stop message.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid Unconditional Emergency Stop message. A valid new Movement Authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Send an Unconditional Emergency Stop message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and trips the train immediately.

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU while the emergency stop is active.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA. The train remains in the tripped state or the emergency stop state, and no new movement authority is applied.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of new MA after Emergency Stop revocation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has accepted a Conditional Emergency Stop message and is currently rejecting new MAs.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message for the active Emergency Stop. A valid new Movement Authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for the active Emergency Stop to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the revocation. The emergency stop state is cleared.

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA and updates the EOA/SvL according to the new MA.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges revocation of emergency message
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where it can receive radio messages (e.g., FSD or OS). An emergency message with a specific identifier (NID_EM) has been previously received and acknowledged by the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message (Message 18) containing the NID_EM of the previously received emergency message and M_ACK set to 1.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio link is stable and allows for message transmission and reception.

steps.action: Send a revocation message (Message 18) from the RBC to the OBU. The message must contain the NID_EM of the active emergency message and the M_ACK field set to 1 (acknowledgement requested).
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and processes it. The emergency message associated with the NID_EM is revoked on the OBU.

steps.action: Monitor the uplink radio traffic from the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the RBC. The acknowledgement message refers to the time stamp of the revocation message sent by the trackside, as per SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.3.

test_cases.title: OBU does not acknowledge inconsistent revocation message
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where it can receive radio messages. No emergency message with the identifier NID_EM_X is currently active on the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message (Message 18) containing an NID_EM (NID_EM_X) that does not correspond to any active emergency message on the OBU, with M_ACK set to 1.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU validates the consistency of the revocation message against its internal state of emergency messages.

steps.action: Send a revocation message (Message 18) from the RBC to the OBU with an NID_EM that is not currently active on the OBU. Set M_ACK to 1.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies the message as inconsistent (referring to a non-existent or already revoked emergency message).

steps.action: Monitor the uplink radio traffic from the OBU to the RBC for a period sufficient to cover the expected acknowledgement timeout.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an acknowledgement message for this specific revocation message, in accordance with SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.1 which states that acknowledgement is sent 'unless this message is considered as inconsistent'.

test_cases.title: On-Sight mode: Trackside speed limit overrides National value

test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside speed limit: 20 km/h

steps.action: Observe the applied speed limit in the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the trackside speed limit of 20 km/h, not the National value of 30 km/h.

steps.action: Observe the applied speed limit in the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the trackside speed limit of 80 km/h, not the National value of 100 km/h.

steps.action: Observe the applied speed limit in the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the trackside speed limit of 15 km/h, not the National value of 30 km/h.

steps.action: Observe the applied speed limit in the OBU.

test_cases.title: Limited Supervision mode: Trackside speed limit lower than National value
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Limited Supervision mode. The National value for Limited Supervision speed limit is 100 km/h. The trackside sends a Mode Profile with a speed limit of 50 km/h.

steps.action: Observe the applied speed limit in the OBU.

test_cases.title: Shunting mode: Trackside speed limit equal to National value
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Shunting mode. The National value for Shunting speed limit is 30 km/h. The trackside sends a Mode Profile with a speed limit of 30 km/h.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside speed limit: 30 km/h

steps.action: Observe the applied speed limit in the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the speed limit of 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: Initial computation of PBD speed restriction upon receipt of trackside data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive trackside data. No active PBD speed restriction is currently applied.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid non-continuous profile message from trackside containing: start location, end location, a permitted braking distance (PBD) value, brake type (Emergency), and a single gradient value.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured with valid train parameters (mass, braking characteristics) required for the calculation.

steps.action: Send the trackside profile message containing the PBD data to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data and initiates the calculation of the speed restriction.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's internal speed restriction state or output.
steps.expected: The OBU computes and applies a non-zero speed restriction value (V_PBD) based on the received PBD data.

test_cases.title: Recomputation of PBD speed restriction only when inputs change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an active PBD speed restriction computed from a previous trackside message.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. A new trackside profile message with identical PBD inputs (same PBD value, same gradient, same brake type, same locations). 2. A new trackside profile message with a changed PBD value.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the calculation trigger status or allows observation of the calculation process.

steps.action: Send a new trackside profile message with identical PBD inputs to the current active restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU does not recompute the speed restriction. The existing restriction value remains unchanged.

steps.action: Send a new trackside profile message with a different PBD value (e.g., increased PBD).
steps.expected: The OBU recomputes the speed restriction. The new restriction value reflects the updated PBD input.

test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions: Gradient compensation and deceleration profiles
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with specific train mass and rotating mass parameters. Trackside sends a PBD request with a non-zero gradient.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside profile with a specific gradient value (e.g., 5‰) and PBD. OBU internal configuration for rotating mass compensation.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface or log that reveals the intermediate values used in the calculation (compensated gradient, safe deceleration, expected deceleration).

steps.action: Send a PBD request with a known gradient value.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the compensated gradient by adjusting the received gradient value according to the rotating mass factor defined in SUBSET-026 §3.13.4.3.

steps.action: Inspect the deceleration values used in the calculation.
steps.expected: The safe deceleration is computed ignoring trackside adhesion profiles, brake inhibition, and powerless section conditions. The expected deceleration is computed ignoring brake inhibition and powerless section conditions.

steps.action: Inspect the estimated acceleration value used in the calculation.
steps.expected: The estimated acceleration is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions: Fixed delays and speed inaccuracy compensation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with standard national values for delays and speed inaccuracy compensation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside profile with a PBD value that results in a specific V_PBD.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface or log that reveals the intermediate values: V_delta0PBD, T41, T_bs1, T_bs2, T_traction.

steps.action: Trigger a PBD calculation and inspect the speed inaccuracy compensation value (V_delta0PBD).
steps.expected: V_delta0PBD is calculated using the function f41 based on the PBD speed, as defined in SUBSET-041 §5.3.1.2, unless inhibited by National Value.

steps.action: Inspect the processing delay (T41) used in the offset calculation.
steps.expected: T41 is set to the value defined in SUBSET-041 §5.2.1.1.

steps.action: Inspect the brake feedback times (T_bs1, T_bs2) and traction cut-off time (T_traction).
steps.expected: T_bs1 and T_bs2 are defined as if service brake feedback was not implemented. T_traction is defined as if traction cut-off was not implemented, regardless of actual configuration.

test_cases.title: Computation of PBD speed restriction for Emergency Brake
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive PBD data. Trackside requests PBD to be achieved with Emergency Brake.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside profile with PBD value, Emergency Brake type, and valid gradient.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface or log that reveals the calculated V_PBD and the EBD curve parameters.

steps.action: Send a PBD request specifying Emergency Brake.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the EBD curve based on safe deceleration, reaching zero speed at the permitted braking distance.

steps.action: Observe the computed V_PBD value.
steps.expected: The V_PBD value satisfies the inequalities in SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6 (ABS{(V_PBD + dV_ebi) - (V_EBD(d_offset + D_bec) - V_delta0PBD)} <= 1 km/h and d_offset + D_bec <= d_PBD).

steps.action: Check the final applied speed restriction.
steps.expected: The resulting V_PBD is rounded down to the next lower multiple of 5 km/h.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction set to zero when no speed satisfies inequalities
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive PBD data. Trackside requests PBD to be achieved with Emergency Brake.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside profile with a very small PBD value (e.g., 10 meters) that is physically impossible to stop within given braking characteristics.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface or log that reveals the calculation outcome.

steps.action: Send a PBD request with a PBD value too short for any speed to satisfy the stopping inequalities.
steps.expected: The OBU attempts to find a V_PBD satisfying the inequalities in SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6.

steps.action: Observe the computed V_PBD value.
steps.expected: Since no speed value fulfills the inequalities, the OBU sets V_PBD to 0.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start indication based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored on-board. The train is moving towards the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 100 km/h. Distance to tunnel stopping area start (Point D) is set such that the estimated front end reaches the announcement trigger point (Point C).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is calculated by the OBU based on current speed and driver reaction time as per Appendix A.3.1. The announcement trigger point C is located rear of Point D.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the location (Point C) in rear of the tunnel stopping area start (Point D).
steps.expected: The OBU displays the 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' to the driver.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end reaches the start location (Point D) of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' is no longer displayed, and the 'Tunnel stopping area' information is displayed to the driver.

test_cases.title: Sound horn area start indication based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A sound horn track condition is stored on-board. The train is moving towards the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 80 km/h. Distance to sound horn area start (Point D) is set such that the estimated front end reaches the trigger point (Point C).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is calculated by the OBU based on current speed and driver reaction time. The trigger point C is located rear of Point D.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the location (Point C) in rear of the sound horn area start (Point D).
steps.expected: The OBU displays the 'Sound horn' indication to the driver.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end reaches the end location (Point E) of the sound horn area.
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is no longer displayed.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of tunnel stopping area start with high speed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored on-board.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 300 km/h (maximum operational speed).
test_cases.assumptions: At higher speeds, the distance between Point C and Point D increases to account for the longer reaction time and braking distance.

steps.action: Set the train speed to 300 km/h and move towards the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the trigger point C further away from Point D compared to lower speeds.

steps.action: Observe the display when the estimated front end reaches the calculated Point C.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' is displayed, confirming the evaluation uses the estimated front end adjusted for speed.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of sound horn area end with low speed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A sound horn track condition is stored on-board. The 'Sound horn' indication is currently displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 10 km/h (low speed).
test_cases.assumptions: The end of the sound horn area (Point E) is evaluated based on the estimated front end.

steps.action: Move the train at 10 km/h until the estimated front end reaches the end location (Point E) of the sound horn area.
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is removed from the display.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Loading gauge unsuitability
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive route suitability data. The stored Train Data includes a specific loading gauge profile (e.g., 'G1').
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of permitted loading gauges that does NOT include the train's stored loading gauge ('G1').

steps.action: Transmit route suitability data to the OBU where the list of permitted loading gauges excludes the train's current loading gauge.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies a loading gauge unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's response to the unsuitability.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist and informs the driver about the unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Axle load category unsuitability
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive route suitability data. The stored Train Data includes a specific axle load category (e.g., 'A1').
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of permitted axle load categories that does NOT include the train's stored axle load category ('A1').

steps.action: Transmit route suitability data to the OBU where the list of permitted axle load categories excludes the train's current axle load category.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies an axle load category unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's response to the unsuitability.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist and informs the driver about the unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Traction system unsuitability
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive route suitability data. The stored Train Data includes a list of traction systems accepted by the engine (e.g., 'Electric 25kV'). The engine is NOT capable of running on a line without any traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a traction system (e.g., 'Diesel') that is NOT in the list of traction systems accepted by the engine.

steps.action: Transmit route suitability data to the OBU where the traction system received is not among those accepted by the engine.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies a traction system unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's response to the unsuitability.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist and informs the driver about the unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: All parameters suitable
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive route suitability data. The stored Train Data includes loading gauge 'G1', axle load 'A1', and accepts traction 'Electric 25kV'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside where the permitted loading gauges include 'G1', permitted axle loads include 'A1', and the traction system is 'Electric 25kV'.

steps.action: Transmit route suitability data to the OBU where all parameters match the stored Train Data.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and finds no unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's status.
steps.expected: The OBU does not report any unsuitability and allows the train to run without restriction based on route suitability.

test_cases.title: Traction system exception: Engine can run without traction
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive route suitability data. The stored Train Data indicates that the engine is able to run on a line not fitted with any traction system. The list of traction systems accepted by the engine does NOT include the traction system received from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a traction system that is not in the engine's accepted list.

steps.action: Transmit route suitability data to the OBU where the traction system received is not among those accepted by the engine, but the engine is capable of running without traction.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's assessment of traction system suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT find a traction system unsuitability.

test_cases.title: No route suitability data: Initial state and operation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in its initial state or has been reset such that no route suitability data has been received from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: No route suitability data is transmitted from trackside.

steps.action: Ensure no route suitability data is received from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU maintains its initial state regarding route suitability.

steps.action: Check if the OBU uses or supervises any default route suitability values.
steps.expected: The OBU does not use or supervise any default route suitability values.

steps.action: Attempt to move the train.
steps.expected: The OBU allows the train to run without any route suitability restriction.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with class 'auxiliary information' and 'acknowledgement not requested'.

steps.action: Transmit a text message from trackside with class 'auxiliary information' and no driver acknowledgement request.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for auxiliary information without acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with class 'important information' and 'acknowledgement requested'.

steps.action: Transmit a text message from trackside with class 'important information' and driver acknowledgement requested.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for important information with acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (OR logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., Location A and Speed > 10 km/h) and Q_TEXTDISPLAY=0 (OR logic).

steps.action: Transmit the text message. Set train location to A but speed to 0 km/h.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled because one sub-condition is met. The OBU starts evaluating the end condition.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (AND logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., Location A and Speed > 10 km/h) and Q_TEXTDISPLAY=1 (AND logic).

steps.action: Transmit the text message. Set train location to A but speed to 0 km/h.
steps.expected: The start condition is not fulfilled because not all sub-conditions are met.

steps.action: Increase train speed to > 10 km/h while remaining at Location A.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled because all sub-conditions are met. The OBU starts evaluating the end condition.

test_cases.title: Start condition with no sub-conditions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with no start sub-conditions defined.

steps.action: Transmit the text message with no start sub-conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as immediately fulfilled and starts evaluating the end condition.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: A text message requesting acknowledgement is displayed. The end condition is not yet fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Message configuration: Acknowledgement is defined as 'always ending the text display'.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the text message.
steps.expected: The text display ends immediately, even though the end condition is not fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement is necessary condition for ending display
test_cases.preconditions: A text message requesting acknowledgement is displayed. The end condition is not yet fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Message configuration: Acknowledgement is defined as 'necessary condition to end the text display'.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the text message.
steps.expected: The text display does not end because the end condition is not fulfilled.

steps.action: Fulfil the end condition (e.g., pass the end location).
steps.expected: The text display ends because both the end condition and acknowledgement are fulfilled.

test_cases.title: No display if end condition is immediately fulfilled
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start condition fulfilled immediately (no sub-conditions) and end condition fulfilled immediately (e.g., end location is behind current position).

steps.action: Transmit the text message where the end condition is already fulfilled at the moment the start condition is evaluated.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the message at all.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start sub-condition 'Location A' and end sub-condition 'Location B' (where B is 100m after A).

steps.action: Transmit the text message. Train passes Location A.
steps.expected: The text message is displayed.

steps.action: Train travels 100m from Location A to Location B.
steps.expected: The text message display ends at Location B, confirming the length was measured from the start location.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement report sent to RBC
test_cases.preconditions: A text message requesting a report of driver acknowledgement is displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Message includes text message identifier 'ID-123' and RBC identity 'RBC-1'.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the text message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a driver acknowledgement report to RBC-1 including the text message identifier 'ID-123'.

test_cases.title: Rejection of duplicate text message identifier
test_cases.preconditions: A text message with identifier 'ID-456' requesting a report of driver acknowledgement has been received and is not yet acknowledged.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new text message with identifier 'ID-456' requesting a report of driver acknowledgement.

steps.action: Transmit a new text message with identifier 'ID-456' requesting a report of driver acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new text message.

test_cases.title: Infill MA with OS Mode Profile: Deletion beyond infill reference
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising an OS Mode Profile. The train is located before the infill reference location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA containing a new OS Mode Profile. Infill reference location is defined.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill reference location is within the length of the currently supervised OS Mode Profile.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the MA.

steps.action: Check the status of the OS Mode Profile before the infill reference location.
steps.expected: The OS Mode Profile remains active and supervised up to the infill reference location.

steps.action: Check the status of the Mode Profile beyond the infill reference location.
steps.expected: The previous OS Mode Profile is deleted beyond the infill reference location. The new Mode Profile from the infill MA is applied beyond the infill reference location.

test_cases.title: Infill MA with SH Mode Profile: Infill reference at SH start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a SH Mode Profile. The train is located before the start of the SH Mode Profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA containing a new Mode Profile. Infill reference location is exactly at the start location of the supervised SH Mode Profile.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the MA.

steps.action: Check the status of the SH Mode Profile.
steps.expected: The supervised SH Mode Profile is deleted.

steps.action: Check the status of the new Mode Profile in the infill MA.
steps.expected: The new Mode Profile is applied.

test_cases.title: Infill MA with SH Mode Profile: Infill reference in rear of SH start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a SH Mode Profile. The train is located before the start of the SH Mode Profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA containing a new Mode Profile. Infill reference location is in rear of the start location of the supervised SH Mode Profile.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the MA.

steps.action: Check the status of the SH Mode Profile.
steps.expected: The supervised SH Mode Profile is deleted.

steps.action: Check the status of the new Mode Profile in the infill MA.
steps.expected: The new Mode Profile is applied.

test_cases.title: Infill MA with SH Mode Profile: Infill reference in advance of SH start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a SH Mode Profile. The train is located before the start of the SH Mode Profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA containing a new Mode Profile and a list of balise groups for SH area. Infill reference location is in advance of the start location of the supervised SH Mode Profile.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the MA.

steps.action: Check the status of the SH Mode Profile.
steps.expected: The supervised SH Mode Profile is NOT deleted and remains active.

steps.action: Check the status of the Mode Profile and SH balise group list in the infill MA.
steps.expected: The Mode Profile and the list of balise groups for SH area included in the infill MA are ignored by the OBU.

test_cases.title: Temporary EOA and SvL at Mode Profile start when required
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a Mode Profile that requires a temporary SvL. The OBU has not yet switched to the Mode Profile's mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile with 'temporary SvL required' flag set to true.

steps.action: Check the EOA status.
steps.expected: The beginning of the Mode Profile is considered as a temporary EOA.

steps.action: Check the SvL status.
steps.expected: A temporary SvL without release speed is considered at the beginning of the Mode Profile.

test_cases.title: Temporary SvL calculation when not required and LOA at/beyond profile start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a Mode Profile that does NOT require a temporary SvL. The MA defines an LOA located at or in advance of the Mode Profile start. The OBU has not yet switched to the Mode Profile's mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile with 'temporary SvL required' flag set to false. MA with LOA at or beyond Mode Profile start.
test_cases.assumptions: The calculation per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5 as if no LOA were given results in a specific location L_calc.

steps.action: Check the EOA status.
steps.expected: The beginning of the Mode Profile is considered as a temporary EOA.

steps.action: Check the SvL status.
steps.expected: A temporary SvL without release speed is considered at the location determined in accordance with 3.8.4.5 as if no LOA had been given (L_calc).

test_cases.title: Temporary SvL at profile start when not required and LOA in rear
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a Mode Profile that does NOT require a temporary SvL. The MA defines an LOA located in rear of the Mode Profile start. The OBU has not yet switched to the Mode Profile's mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile with 'temporary SvL required' flag set to false. MA with LOA in rear of Mode Profile start.

steps.action: Check the EOA status.
steps.expected: The beginning of the Mode Profile is considered as a temporary EOA.

steps.action: Check the SvL status.
steps.expected: A temporary SvL without release speed is considered at the beginning of the Mode Profile.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Level Crossing information with same identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it accepts Level Crossing (LX) information. An initial LX information set with Identity 'LX-001' is already stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new LX information message with Identity 'LX-001' but different parameters (e.g., different length or protection status) than the stored one.

steps.action: Transmit the new LX information with Identity 'LX-001' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new information.

steps.action: Inspect the stored LX information for Identity 'LX-001' in the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored LX information matches the parameters of the newly received information, confirming the old data was replaced.

test_cases.title: Independence of Level Crossing information with different identities
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it accepts Level Crossing (LX) information. An initial LX information set with Identity 'LX-001' is already stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new LX information message with Identity 'LX-002' (different from stored) and different parameters.

steps.action: Transmit the new LX information with Identity 'LX-002' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new information.

steps.action: Inspect the stored LX information for Identity 'LX-001' in the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored LX information for 'LX-001' remains unchanged, confirming that the new information with a different identity did not replace it.

test_cases.title: AAL2 için phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama seçeneğinin sunulması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem AAL2 seviyesinde yapılandırılmıştır ve en az bir phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulayıcı (ör. FIDO2/WebAuthn) desteklenmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: AAL2 gerektiren bir giriş noktası.
test_cases.assumptions: Phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama, NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.2.5'te tanımlandığı gibi, sahte doğrulayıcıya kimlik doğrulama sırlarının ifşasını önleyen kriptografik bir protokoldür.

steps.action: AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama gerektiren bir sayfaya veya servise erişim sağlanır.
steps.expected: Sistem, kullanıcıya en az bir phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama seçeneği sunar (örneğin, 'FIDO2 ile Giriş Yap' veya 'WebAuthn ile Doğrula' butonu).

steps.action: Sunulan phishing-dirençli seçeneği kullanarak kimlik doğrulama işlemi başlatılır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama akışı, phishing-dirençli protokolün gerektirdiği şekilde (örneğin, cihazda yerel onay veya biyometrik aktivasyon) ilerler ve başarılı bir oturum açma sağlanır.

test_cases.title: AAL2'de yalnızca phishing-dirençli olmayan seçeneklerin sunulmaması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem AAL2 seviyesinde yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: AAL2 gerektiren bir giriş noktası.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, AAL2 için yalnızca parola veya tek faktörlü OTP gibi phishing-dirençli olmayan yöntemler sunarsa gereksinimi ihlal etmiş olur.

steps.action: AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama gerektiren bir sayfaya erişim sağlanır ve sunulan kimlik doğrulama seçenekleri incelenir.
steps.expected: Sistem, en az bir phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama seçeneği sunmalıdır. Eğer yalnızca parola veya standart OTP gibi phishing-dirençli olmayan seçenekler sunuluyorsa, bu bir hata olarak işaretlenir ve test başarısız olur.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication with multi-factor authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 using a multi-factor authenticator (e.g., a device with integrated biometric sensor).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid multi-factor authenticator credentials.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the multi-factor authenticator input.

steps.action: Provide the required activation factor (e.g., biometric scan) to the multi-factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The authenticator generates a valid cryptographic response.

steps.action: Submit the authentication request to the VBP system.
steps.expected: The system verifies the credentials and grants access, confirming successful AAL2 authentication.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication with two separate authentication factors
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 using two separate authentication factors (e.g., password and OTP).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password and valid one-time password (OTP).

steps.action: Initiate the login process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the first authentication factor (password).

steps.action: Enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second authentication factor (OTP).

steps.action: Enter the valid OTP.
steps.expected: The system verifies both factors and grants access, confirming successful AAL2 authentication.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication failure with single factor only
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 using two separate authentication factors (e.g., password and OTP).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password, missing OTP.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the first authentication factor (password).

steps.action: Enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second authentication factor (OTP).

steps.action: Attempt to proceed without providing the OTP.
steps.expected: The system denies access and displays an error message indicating that the second factor is required.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication failure with invalid second factor
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 using two separate authentication factors (e.g., password and OTP).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password, invalid OTP.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the first authentication factor (password).

steps.action: Enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second authentication factor (OTP).

steps.action: Enter an invalid OTP.
steps.expected: The system denies access and displays an error message indicating that the OTP is incorrect.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunda inactivity timeout'unun tetiklenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP sistemi AAL2 yapılandırmasıyla çalışmaktadır. Kullanıcı aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. SDD §14'te tanımlanan inactivity timeout süresi (örneğin 1 saat) bilinmektedir.
test_cases.assumptions: SDD §14'te AAL2 için inactivity timeout süresinin 1 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, AAL2 kimlik doğrulamasını tamamlayarak oturum açar.
steps.expected: Oturum başarıyla başlatılır ve kullanıcı aktif sayfalara erişebilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, SDD §14'te belirtilen inactivity timeout süresinden (1 saat) daha uzun bir süre boyunca hiçbir işlem yapmaz.
steps.expected: Sistem, inactivity timeout'unun dolduğunu algılar.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, timeout süresi dolduktan sonra sayfada bir işlem yapmaya çalışır.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlandırılır ve kullanıcı yeniden kimlik doğrulaması (reauthentication) için yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunda overall timeout'unun tetiklenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP sistemi AAL2 yapılandırmasıyla çalışmaktadır. Kullanıcı aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. SDD §14'te tanımlanan overall timeout süresi (örneğin 24 saat) bilinmektedir.
test_cases.assumptions: SDD §14'te AAL2 için overall timeout süresinin 24 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

test_cases.title: No notification sent when only postal address is registered
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with only one notification address registered: a postal address.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger an account notification event.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states notifications are sent to all addresses *except* postal addresses. If no other address exists, the behavior for postal-only accounts is not explicitly defined in KDH-005, but the exception implies postal is excluded. However, NIST 800-63B-4 says postal *shall* be sent if no other form is stored. KDH-005 says 'except postal addresses'. This creates a conflict or a specific interpretation. Let's assume KDH-005 strictly follows the 'except postal' rule for the test, meaning if only postal is present, no notification is sent via the 'all except postal' logic, OR the system handles the 'no other address' case separately. Given the prompt asks to test KDH-005 which says 'except postal', I will test that postal is excluded. If the system is required to send to postal when it's the only one, that would be a different requirement or a conflict. I will assume the test verifies that postal is NOT sent as per the 'except' clause, or that the system handles the edge case. Let's look at the NIST text provided: 'Notifications SHALL be sent to all notification addresses except postal addresses. However, notifications SHALL be sent to postal addresses if no other form of notification address is stored...'. KDH-005 cites NIST 800-63B-4 §4.6. Therefore, KDH-005 implies the full NIST logic. So, if only postal is stored, it SHOULD be sent. But the requirement text says 'except postal addresses'. This is ambiguous. I will write a test for the standard case (multiple addresses) and a boundary case where only postal is present to see if it follows the NIST exception (send to postal) or the literal 'except' (send nothing). Given the citation, it should follow NIST. So, if only postal is present, it should be sent. But the requirement text explicitly says 'except postal'. I will assume the requirement text is the primary source for the test, but the citation implies the full rule. I will create a test for the 'only postal' scenario expecting it to be sent, as per the NIST rule cited, or if the requirement is strictly 'except', then no notification. Let's stick to the explicit text of KDH-005: 'except postal addresses'. If I test 'only postal', and the system sends it, it violates the literal text but follows the citation. If it doesn't send it, it follows the literal text but violates the citation. I will assume the requirement intends to follow the NIST standard fully. Therefore, the 'except' is the general rule, and the 'only postal' is the exception. I will test the general rule in TC-001/002. I will add a test for the 'only postal' case expecting it to be sent, as per the NIST rule referenced.

steps.action: Trigger an account notification event for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system sends a notification to the registered postal address, as it is the only notification address stored.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of a valid, first-time e-Devlet assertion
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured to accept e-Devlet assertions. A valid, unused e-Devlet assertion with a unique nonce/identifier is available.

steps.action: Submit the valid e-Devlet assertion to VBP for the first time.
steps.expected: VBP accepts the assertion and establishes an authenticated session.

test_cases.title: Rejection of a replayed e-Devlet assertion

test_cases.title: Rejection of an assertion with a previously used nonce

steps.action: Submit the e-Devlet assertion with the reused nonce to VBP.
steps.expected: VBP rejects the assertion due to nonce reuse.

test_cases.title: VBP başlatılan federasyon işleminin doğrulanması

steps.expected: İstek, VBP'nin RP kimliğini, benzersiz bir nonce değerini ve istenen öznitelikleri içeren bir federasyon başlatma isteğidir. İstek e-Devlet tarafından başlatılmamıştır.

test_cases.title: e-Devlet tarafından başlatılan işlemin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP ve e-Devlet arasında FAL2 seviyesinde bir güven anlaşması mevcuttur. VBP'nin IdP rolünde davranışını test etmek için sahte bir IdP istemcisi veya ağ manipülasyonu yetkisi vardır.

steps.expected: VBP, bu isteği RP rolü dışı bir girişim olarak algılar ve işlemi başlatmaz.

steps.action: VBP'nin yanıtı ve log kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: VBP isteği reddeder ve güvenlik loglarında 'Geçersiz federasyon başlangıcı' veya benzeri bir hata mesajı kaydedilir. Oturum açılmaz.

test_cases.title: Consistent error message for mismatched self-asserted data
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant account is created with valid identity evidence. The system is configured to validate self-asserted attributes against an authoritative source.
test_cases.test_inputs: Applicant self-asserts a name that does not match the authoritative source record.
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source returns a definitive 'mismatch' result for the provided data.

steps.action: Submit the identity proofing request with the mismatched self-asserted name.
steps.expected: The system displays a generic error message indicating that the identity could not be verified, without specifying which attribute failed or that a mismatch occurred.

steps.action: Compare the error message displayed in this test with the error message displayed when a valid, matching name is submitted (or a different type of failure occurs, e.g., missing data).
steps.expected: The error messages are identical or indistinguishable in a way that does not reveal the specific nature of the validation failure (i.e., it does not say 'name does not match').

test_cases.title: Consistent error message for missing authoritative data
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant account is created. The authoritative source is configured to return 'no record found' for the test applicant's data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Applicant self-asserts a name for which no record exists in the authoritative source.
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source returns a 'not found' or 'no match' result.

steps.action: Submit the identity proofing request with the self-asserted name that has no corresponding record in the authoritative source.
steps.expected: The system displays a generic error message indicating that the identity could not be verified.

steps.action: Compare this error message with the error message generated for a definitive mismatch (as in TC-01).
steps.expected: The error messages are identical or indistinguishable, preventing the applicant from inferring whether the data was missing or simply incorrect.

test_cases.title: No specific attribute feedback on validation failure
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant account is created. The system validates multiple core attributes (e.g., name, date of birth, address).
test_cases.test_inputs: Applicant self-asserts a correct name but an incorrect date of birth.
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source confirms the name but rejects the date of birth.

steps.action: Submit the identity proofing request with the correct name and incorrect date of birth.
steps.expected: The system displays a generic failure message. The message does not indicate that the name was correct or that the date of birth was the specific point of failure.

steps.action: Inspect the user interface and any logs visible to the applicant for hints about which field failed.
steps.expected: No specific field is highlighted, and no detailed diagnostic information is provided to the applicant that would allow them to infer which attribute was mismatched.

test_cases.title: Validation of core attributes via authoritative source comparison
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative is undergoing IAL2 proofing. The system is configured to use an authoritative source for attribute validation.
test_cases.test_inputs: A set of core attributes including a valid government identifier and other core attributes (e.g., name, date of birth) that match the records in the authoritative source.
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source is accessible and contains accurate records for the test subject.

steps.action: Submit the core attributes of the company representative to the VBP system for validation.
steps.expected: The system initiates a comparison of the government identifier and other core attributes against the authoritative source.

steps.action: Observe the validation result.
steps.expected: The system reports that all core attributes have been successfully validated against the authoritative source.

test_cases.title: Validation of digitally signed attributes on SUPERIOR evidence
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative is undergoing IAL2 proofing. The system is configured to validate SUPERIOR evidence.
test_cases.test_inputs: A piece of SUPERIOR identity evidence containing digitally signed core attributes, signed by a trusted issuer.
test_cases.assumptions: The issuer's public key is available in the system's trust store and the digital signature on the evidence is valid.

steps.action: Present the SUPERIOR evidence to the VBP system.
steps.expected: The system extracts the digitally signed attributes from the evidence.

steps.action: Observe the validation process.
steps.expected: The system validates the accuracy of the digitally signed attributes using the issuer's public key.

steps.action: Observe the final validation result.
steps.expected: The system reports that the core attributes on the SUPERIOR evidence have been successfully validated.

test_cases.title: Failure of attribute validation due to mismatch with authoritative source
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative is undergoing IAL2 proofing. The system is configured to use an authoritative source for attribute validation.
test_cases.test_inputs: A set of core attributes where the government identifier matches the authoritative source, but one other core attribute (e.g., date of birth) does not match.
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source is accessible and contains accurate records for the test subject.

steps.action: Submit the core attributes with the mismatched value to the VBP system for validation.
steps.expected: The system initiates a comparison of the attributes against the authoritative source.

steps.action: Observe the validation result.
steps.expected: The system reports a validation failure, indicating that the core attributes could not be validated due to a mismatch with the authoritative source.

test_cases.title: Failure of attribute validation due to invalid digital signature on SUPERIOR evidence
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative is undergoing IAL2 proofing. The system is configured to validate SUPERIOR evidence.
test_cases.test_inputs: A piece of SUPERIOR identity evidence containing digitally signed core attributes, but with an invalid or tampered digital signature.
test_cases.assumptions: The issuer's public key is available in the system's trust store.

steps.action: Present the SUPERIOR evidence with the invalid signature to the VBP system.
steps.expected: The system attempts to validate the digitally signed attributes using the issuer's public key.

steps.action: Observe the validation result.
steps.expected: The system reports a validation failure, indicating that the digital signature on the SUPERIOR evidence could not be verified.

test_cases.title: IAL2 Company Representative Proofing Notification Content and Delivery
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant representing a company has a validated postal address and phone number in the system. The IAL2 identity proofing process is ready to be executed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid IAL2 identity evidence for a company representative.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to send notifications via postal mail and SMS/Phone call as per the validated addresses.

steps.action: Initiate and complete the IAL2 identity proofing process for the company representative using valid evidence.
steps.expected: The system records the identity proofing as successful.

steps.action: Verify that a notification of proofing is sent to the applicant's validated postal address.
steps.expected: A physical notification is dispatched to the validated postal address.

steps.action: Verify that a notification of proofing is sent to the applicant's validated phone number.
steps.expected: A notification (e.g., SMS or automated call) is sent to the validated phone number.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the notification sent to the postal address.

test_cases.title: Successful authentication resets failure count and re-enables authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account has both password and second-factor authenticators disabled due to reaching the failure threshold in a previous test.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password and valid second-factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The account recovery process allows re-enabling or re-binding of authenticators after a successful authentication or manual reset. For this test, assume the system allows re-enabling after a successful authentication with a different valid method or after manual admin reset, but the requirement states 'disable', so we test the state after disable. However, the requirement says 'disable all of the authenticators involved'. It does not explicitly state auto-re-enable on success. NIST 800-63B-4 says 'Authenticators that have been disabled SHALL be required to rebind'. So we test that they remain disabled until rebind/re-enable action is taken.

steps.action: Verify that both password and second-factor authenticators are currently disabled.
steps.expected: Both authenticators are in a disabled state.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the disabled password and second-factor.
steps.expected: Authentication is rejected because the authenticators are disabled.

test_cases.title: Disabled authenticator requires re-binding before use

test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the disabled authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The binding process described in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1 is implemented and accessible.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the disabled authenticator without re-binding.
steps.expected: Authentication is rejected. The system indicates that the authenticator is disabled and requires re-binding.

steps.action: Initiate and complete the re-binding process for the authenticator to the company representative account as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.
steps.expected: The re-binding process completes successfully. The authenticator status changes to active/bound.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the re-bound authenticator.
steps.expected: Authentication is successful.

test_cases.title: Authentication rejected if re-binding is not completed
test_cases.preconditions: An authenticator has been disabled due to reaching the failed-attempt threshold. The re-binding process has been initiated but not completed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the disabled authenticator.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the authenticator while the re-binding process is incomplete.
steps.expected: Authentication is rejected. The system indicates that the authenticator is not yet bound or is still disabled.

steps.expected: VBP yanıtı işler ve tüm xAL gereksinimlerinin karşılandığını tespit eder.
